skill.name: launch
skill.description: When the user wants to plan a product launch, feature announcement, or release strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'launch,' 'Product Hunt,' 'feature release,' 'announcement,' 'go-to-market,' 'beta launch,' 'early access,' 'waitlist,' 'product update,' 'how do I launch this,' 'launch checklist,' 'GTM plan,' or 'we're about to ship.' Use this whenever someone is preparing to release something publicly. For ongoing marketing after launch, see marketing-ideas. For the offer being launched (bonuses, guarantees, scarcity, naming), see offers.
skill.summary: Plan product launches, feature releases, and go-to-market campaigns with phased validation, channel strategy, and post-launch follow-through.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

content.user_title: Plan a Product Launch That Builds Momentum
content.value_statement: Launch planning becomes difficult when teams lack a clear sequence, audience strategy, and readiness criteria. This skill creates a phased plan from validation through post-launch adoption.
actual_capabilities: Builds phased launch plans covering internal, alpha, beta, early access, and full launch stages.
Applies the Owned, Rented, and Borrowed channel framework to audience and distribution planning.
Evaluates launch readiness with the Simple, Lovable, Complete gate.
Creates Product Hunt preparation, launch-day, and follow-up actions.
Organizes pre-launch, launch-day, and post-launch checklists.
Suggests post-launch onboarding, announcement, comparison, and feedback activities.
limitations: It does not access analytics, customer records, product environments, or external marketing platforms.
Its recommendations depend on the audience, product stage, resources, and timeline provided by the user.
It does not guarantee traffic, rankings, conversions, or Product Hunt performance.
It provides strategy guidance rather than final copy, legal advice, or campaign execution.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New SaaS Launch
use_cases.description: Create a staged plan for validating a SaaS product, building a waitlist, and opening access to early users.

use_cases.title: Announce a Major Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a significant feature release into coordinated email, in-app, social, and community announcements.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Product Hunt Campaign
use_cases.description: Plan supporter outreach, listing preparation, launch-day engagement, and post-launch signup follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: I am launching [product] for [audience] on [date]. Create a simple phased launch plan with key actions and owners.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Launch Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether [product] is Simple, Lovable, and Complete for [target user]. Identify launch blockers and the smallest useful scope.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Channel Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: For [product] and [audience], recommend owned, rented, and borrowed channels. Prioritize two channels per type and explain each choice.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Launch Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed launch campaign for [product] from [date] through 30 days after launch. Include phases, channel actions, messaging themes, metrics, owners, and follow-up experiments.

output_examples.input: We are launching a team habit tracker for remote startups in six weeks.
output_examples.output: A six-week plan covering readiness review, private testing, waitlist growth, beta invitations, launch messaging, and post-launch onboarding.

output_examples.input: We want to launch our new reporting dashboard on Product Hunt.
output: Before launch: refine the listing, prepare visuals, brief supporters, and test signup flow.
Launch day: respond to comments, share useful context, and direct visitors to an owned signup channel.
After launch: follow up with engaged visitors, review feedback, and publish adoption content.

output_examples.input: Our team keeps delaying launch for more features.
output_examples.output: A readiness diagnosis using the Simple, Lovable, Complete gate, followed by scope cuts and a focused launch sequence.

best_practices: Define one target audience, one launch goal, and one primary conversion action.
Capture rented and borrowed attention in owned channels such as email, community, or your website.
Use feedback and adoption data to plan the next launch moment after the initial announcement.
anti_patterns: Do not treat launch day as the entire marketing strategy.
Do not depend on one rented platform for all discovery and conversion.
Do not expand scope indefinitely when the current product is already useful and complete.

faq.question: What types of launches does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports new products, major features, beta programs, early access releases, and smaller product updates.

faq.question: Can it create a launch checklist?
faq.answer: Yes. It organizes pre-launch, launch-day, and post-launch tasks around your product and timeline.

faq.question: Does it support Product Hunt launches?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers listing preparation, supporter outreach, launch-day engagement, and post-launch follow-up.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Share what you are launching, the target audience, current channels, timeline, available resources, and previous launch experience.

faq.question: Can it write the complete campaign for me?
faq.answer: It can structure the campaign and recommend messaging themes, but it does not execute campaigns or replace product-specific copy review.

faq.question: Is this useful after launch?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes onboarding, follow-up, feedback collection, comparison content, and ongoing announcement planning.
